description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Nuwara Eliya District
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with electoral processes for Local Authorities, including the postponement of a poll date due to funding issues, notifications under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, and the announcement that a new election date will be set. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover election announcements, schedules, and related electoral commission matters.
